title: Lekalo PHP Routes Evidence
description: Closed contract for the observed-route evidence document the checked route mode joins (issue #60). The document is produced outside the compiler by a controlled producer (the project's own route-scanner lane, conventionally `artisan route:list --json` joined with the controller sources) and staged under `.lekalo/import/observed/routes-evidence.json`; the adapter only validates its shape and digests and joins it against the declared routes. No route registration is checked without this scanner evidence, and presence of a document with plausible digests is never trusted as producer execution: the producer receipt reference must validate, and a missing, stale, ambiguous or partial record is a typed finding - never a pass, never a silent rewrite. The document is pure data - no credentials, hosts, URLs, users, wall-clock timestamps, or provider output.

irDigest.description: The IR evidence digest the observation was produced against; a stale digest makes every record unknown.

routesInputDigest.description: The routes input document digest the observation was produced against.

producer.description: The controlled producer receipt: the tool, its pinned version, and the exact receipt document the run recorded. The join validates the reference but never fabricates execution.

sources.description: The complete observed source inventory, path-sorted; every route record's controller path must appear here with the identical digest.

routes.description: One record per observed route, sorted by (method, uri, name); every declared route must match exactly one record.

uri.description: The observed route uri as the scanner spelled it, `{param}` placeholders included, leading slash included.

name.description: The observed route name; an empty string when the route carries none.

action.description: The observed action identity: the controller FQN and method joined with `@`.

path.description: The case-preserving native path of the controller source as observed; the join lowercases only for the wire.

digest.description: The sha256 of the exact observed controller source bytes.

middleware.description: The observed middleware spellings, sorted; absence declares none observed.
